test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Ram is at A and Shyam is at B. They proceed towards each other simultaneously. After meeting each other in the way, Ram takes 2 h to reach B and Shyam takes 8 h to reach A. If the speed of Ram is 40 km/h, the speed of Shyam is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Ram = 40 km/hour

Time is taken by Ram to reach B = 2 hours

Time is taken by Shyam to reach A = 8 hours

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Speed of Ram/ Speed of Shyam = √(Time of Shyam/Time taken by Ram)

**Solution:**

Speed of Shyam = b km/h

Speed of Ram/ Speed of Shyam = √(Time of Shyam/Time taken by Ram)

⇒ 40/b = √(8/2)

⇒ 40/b = 2

⇒ b = 20 km/hour

Hence speed of Shyam = 20 km/hour.
